purpose: Reproducible audit and secondary reanalysis of the existing Phase-6/7 24-hour spot-liquidity forecasting evidence
claim_type: predictive validation only; no causal identification
external_data_status: 2024-03 onward outcomes and forecast scores were already inspected in Phase 7; no fresh untouched confirmation
data_policy: reuse cached panel and raw archives only; no network or new market-data download
asset_rule: reuse all assets mechanically selected before Phase-7 estimation under the frozen outcome-blind coverage/timestamp rules
development_selected_best_family: minimum development-only pooled transformed OOF MAE separately within each matched information set; no external model selection

stress_warning.alarm_threshold: development OOF prediction q90 per asset/target/info-set/family
stress_warning.aggregation: average MLP/GRU within the neural category, then equal-weight the five independent categories

negative_controls.name: future_derivatives_after_target
negative_controls.matched_baseline: six Spot Only lags through t

negative_controls.name: 42_interval_forward_displacement
negative_controls.matched_baseline: six Spot Only lags through t

classification: retain the frozen Phase-7 external replication and cross-proxy rules; exploratory reanalysis cannot override them
